hall: The Town Hall is where Nib keeps the big book of every resident. Nothing to do inside yet; chapter two opens it.
bank: The bank is a cash machine. There’s nothing to do here yet.
print: The print shop has sticker packs in its window. Nothing to do here yet; buy packs in the site’s shop.
wheel: Spinner’s Wheel of Peel gives one free spin a day. Paid spins cost a few coins, feed the pot, and one wedge wins it.
exchange: The Exchange is where Fig Jr. buys your eggs, milk, and wool. Today’s price changes daily: sell now or hold.
oldCabinet: This old arcade cabinet is out of order. There’s nothing to play here yet.
